versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה תּוֹלְדֹ֥ת אַהֲרֹ֖ן וּמֹשֶׁ֑ה בְּי֗וֹם דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּהַ֥ר סִינָֽי׃

controles.web: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that Yahweh spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.
controles.kjv: These also are the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the Lord spake with Moses in mount Sinai.
controles.livre: E estas são as gerações de Arão e de Moisés, desde que o SENHOR falou a Moisés no monte Sinai.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־אַהֲרֹ֖ן הַבְּכ֣וֹר׀ נָדָ֑ב וַאֲבִיה֕וּא אֶלְעָזָ֖ר וְאִיתָמָֽר׃

controles.web: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
controles.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron; Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
controles.livre: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Arão: Nadabe o primogênito, e Abiú, Eleazar, e Itamar.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמוֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים הַמְּשֻׁחִ֑ים אֲשֶׁר־מִלֵּ֥א יָדָ֖ם לְכַהֵֽן׃

controles.web: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
controles.kjv: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests which were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.
controles.livre: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Arão, sacerdotes ungidos; cujas mãos ele encheu para administrar o sacerdócio.

versos.hebraico: וַיָּ֣מָת נָדָ֣ב וַאֲבִיה֣וּא לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֡ה בְּֽהַקְרִבָם֩ אֵ֨שׁ זָרָ֜ה לִפְנֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ בְּמִדְבַּ֣ר סִינַ֔י וּבָנִ֖ים לֹא־הָי֣וּ לָהֶ֑ם וַיְכַהֵ֤ן אֶלְעָזָר֙ וְאִ֣יתָמָ֔ר עַל־פְּנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֥ן אֲבִיהֶֽם׃פ

controles.web: Nadab and Abihu died before Yahweh, when they offered strange fire before Yahweh, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.
controles.kjv: And Nadab and Abihu died before the Lord, when they offered strange fire before the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children: and Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the sight of Aaron their father.
controles.livre: Mas Nadabe e Abiú morreram diante do SENHOR, quando ofereceram fogo estranho diante do SENHOR, no deserto de Sinai: e não tiveram filhos: e Eleazar e Itamar exerceram o sacerdócio diante de Arão seu pai.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: הַקְרֵב֙ אֶת־מַטֵּ֣ה לֵוִ֔י וְֽהַעֲמַדְתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן וְשֵׁרְת֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.
controles.kjv: Bring the tribe of Levi near, and present them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister unto him.
controles.livre: Faze chegar à tribo de Levi, e faze-a estar diante do sacerdote Arão, para que lhe ministrem;

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁמְר֣וּ אֶת־מִשְׁמַרְתּ֗וֹ וְאֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֨רֶת֙ כָּל־הָ֣עֵדָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.
controles.kjv: And they shall keep his charge, and the charge of the whole congregation before the tabernacle of the congregation, to do the service of the tabernacle.
controles.livre: E desempenhem seu cargo, e o cargo de toda a congregação diante do tabernáculo do testemunho, para servir no ministério do tabernáculo;

versos.hebraico: וְשָׁמְר֗וּ אֶֽת־כָּל־כְּלֵי֙ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וְאֶת־מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־עֲבֹדַ֥ת הַמִּשְׁכָּֽן׃

controles.web: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
controles.kjv: And they shall keep all the instruments of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.
controles.livre: E guardem todos os móveis do tabernáculo do testemunho, e o encarregado a eles dos filhos de Israel, e ministrem no serviço do tabernáculo.

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּה֙ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו נְתוּנִ֨ם נְתוּנִ֥ם הֵ֨מָּה֙ ל֔וֹ מֵאֵ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And thou shalt give the Levites unto Aaron and to his sons: they are wholly given unto him out of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E darás os levitas a Arão e a seus filhos: são inteiramente dados a eles dentre os filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־אַהֲרֹ֤ן וְאֶת־בָּנָיו֙ תִּפְקֹ֔ד וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־כְּהֻנָּתָ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃פ

controles.web: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”
controles.kjv: And thou shalt appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall wait on their priest’s office: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
controles.livre: E constituirás a Arão e a seus filhos, para que exerçam seu sacerdócio: e o estranho que se chegar, morrerá.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה לָקַ֣חְתִּי אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם מִתּוֹךְ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תַּ֧חַת כָּל־בְּכ֛וֹר פֶּ֥טֶר רֶ֖חֶם מִבְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֖י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine:
controles.kjv: And I, behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn that openeth the matrix among the children of Israel: therefore the Levites shall be mine;
controles.livre: E eis que eu tomei os levitas dentre os filhos de Israel em lugar de todos os primogênitos que abrem a madre entre os filhos de Israel; serão, pois, meus os levitas:

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י לִי֮ כָּל־בְּכוֹר֒ בְּיוֹם֩ הַכֹּתִ֨י כָל־בְּכ֜וֹר בְּאֶ֣רֶץ מִצְרַ֗יִם הִקְדַּ֨שְׁתִּי לִ֤י כָל־בְּכוֹר֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאָדָ֖ם עַד־בְּהֵמָ֑ה לִ֥י יִהְי֖וּ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס

controles.web: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahweh.”
controles.kjv: Because all the firstborn are mine; for on the day that I smote all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I hallowed unto me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast: mine shall they be: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Porque meu é todo primogênito; desde o dia que eu matei todos os primogênitos na terra do Egito, eu santifiquei a mim todos os primogênitos em Israel, tanto de homens como de animais; meus serão; Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֔ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י לֵאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
controles.livre: E o SENHOR falou a Moisés no deserto de Sinai, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: פְּקֹד֙ אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִ֔י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָ֖ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כָּל־זָכָ֛ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה תִּפְקְדֵֽם׃

controles.web: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”
controles.kjv: Number the children of Levi after the house of their fathers, by their families: every male from a month old and upward shalt thou number them.
controles.livre: Conta os filhos de Levi pelas casas de seus pais, por suas famílias: contarás todos os homens de um mês acima.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָ֛ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עַל־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צֻוָּֽה׃

controles.web: Moses numbered them according to Yahweh’s word, as he was commanded.
controles.kjv: And Moses numbered them according to the word of the Lord, as he was commanded.
controles.livre: E Moisés os contou conforme a palavra do SENHOR, como lhe foi mandado.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּֽהְיוּ־אֵ֥לֶּה בְנֵֽי־לֵוִ֖י בִּשְׁמֹתָ֑ם גֵּרְשׁ֕וֹן וּקְהָ֖ת וּמְרָרִֽי׃

controles.web: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
controles.kjv: And these were the sons of Levi by their names; Gershon, and Kohath, and Merari.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Levi foram estes por seus nomes: Gérson, e Coate, e Merari.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֛לֶּה שְׁמ֥וֹת בְּֽנֵי־גֵרְשׁ֖וֹן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם לִבְנִ֖י וְשִׁמְעִֽי׃

controles.web: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.
controles.kjv: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families; Libni, and Shimei.
controles.livre: E os nomes dos filhos de Gérson, por suas famílias, estes: Libni, e Simei.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֥י קְהָ֖ת לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם עַמְרָ֣ם וְיִצְהָ֔ר חֶבְר֖וֹן וְעֻזִּיאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, and Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Kohath by their families; Amram, and Izehar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Coate, por suas famílias: Anrão, e Izar, e Hebrom, e Uziel.

versos.hebraico: וּבְנֵ֧י מְרָרִ֛י לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם מַחְלִ֣י וּמוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֛ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַלֵּוִ֖י לְבֵ֥ית אֲבֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi.   These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.
controles.kjv: And the sons of Merari by their families; Mahli, and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to the house of their fathers.
controles.livre: E os filhos de Merari, por suas famílias: Mali, e Musi. Estas, as famílias de Levi, pelas casas de seus pais.

versos.hebraico: לְגֵ֣רְשׁ֔וֹן מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַלִּבְנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַשִּׁמְעִ֑י אֵ֣לֶּה הֵ֔ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּֽי׃

controles.web: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
controles.kjv: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimites: these are the families of the Gershonites.
controles.livre: De Gérson, a família de Libni e a de Simei: estas são as famílias de Gérson.

versos.hebraico: פְּקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה פְּקֻ֣דֵיהֶ֔ם שִׁבְעַ֥ת אֲלָפִ֖ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Those who were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those who were numbered of them were seven thousand five hundred.
controles.kjv: Those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, even those that were numbered of them were seven thousand and five hundred.
controles.livre: Os contados deles conforme a conta de todos os homens de um mês acima, os contados deles, sete mil e quinhentos.

versos.hebraico: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֖ת הַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אַחֲרֵ֧י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ יָֽמָּה׃

controles.web: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
controles.kjv: The families of the Gershonites shall pitch behind the tabernacle westward.
controles.livre: As famílias de Gérson assentarão suas tendas à retaguarda do tabernáculo, ao ocidente;

versos.hebraico: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־אָ֖ב לַגֵּרְשֻׁנִּ֑י אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־לָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
controles.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the Gershonites shall be Eliasaph the son of Lael.
controles.livre: E o chefe da casa do pai dos gersonitas, Eliasafe filho de Lael.

versos.hebraico: וּמִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת בְּנֵֽי־גֵרְשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן וְהָאֹ֑הֶל מִכְסֵ֕הוּ וּמָסַ֕ךְ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃

controles.web: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, its covering, and the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,
controles.kjv: And the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tabernacle of the congregation shall be the tabernacle, and the tent, the covering thereof, and the hanging for the door of the tabernacle of the congregation,
controles.livre: A cargo dos filhos de Gérson, no tabernáculo do testemunho, estará o tabernáculo, e a tenda, e sua cobertura, e a cortina da porta do tabernáculo do testemunho,

versos.hebraico: וְקַלְעֵ֣י הֶֽחָצֵ֗ר וְאֶת־מָסַךְ֙ פֶּ֣תַח הֶֽחָצֵ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֧ר עַל־הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן וְעַל־הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִ֑יב וְאֵת֙ מֵֽיתָרָ֔יו לְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: and the hangings of the court, and the screen for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.
controles.kjv: And the hangings of the court, and the curtain for the door of the court, which is by the tabernacle, and by the altar round about, and the cords of it for all the service thereof.
controles.livre: E as cortinas do átrio, e a cortina da porta do átrio, que está junto ao tabernáculo e junto ao altar ao redor; também suas cordas para todo seu serviço.

versos.hebraico: וְלִקְהָ֗ת מִשְׁפַּ֤חַת הַֽעַמְרָמִי֙ וּמִשְׁפַּ֣חַת הַיִּצְהָרִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַֽחֶבְרֹנִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הָֽעָזִּיאֵלִ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הַקְּהָתִֽי׃

controles.web: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
controles.kjv: And of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, and the family of the Izeharites, and the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites: these are the families of the Kohathites.
controles.livre: E de Coate, a família dos anramitas, e a família dos izaritas, e a família dos hebronitas, e a família dos uzielitas: estas são as famílias coatitas.

versos.hebraico: בְּמִסְפַּר֙ כָּל־זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שְׁמֹנַ֤ת אֲלָפִים֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: According to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.
controles.kjv: In the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were eight thousand and six hundred, keeping the charge of the sanctuary.
controles.livre: Pela conta de todos os homens de um mês acima, eram oito mil e seiscentos, que tinham a guarda do santuário.

versos.hebraico: מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת בְּנֵי־קְהָ֖ת יַחֲנ֑וּ עַ֛ל יֶ֥רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן תֵּימָֽנָה׃

controles.web: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.
controles.kjv: The families of the sons of Kohath shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle southward.
controles.livre: As famílias dos filhos de Coate acamparão ao lado do tabernáculo, ao sul;

versos.hebraico: וּנְשִׂ֥יא בֵֽית־אָ֖ב לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת הַקְּהָתִ֑י אֶלִיצָפָ֖ן בֶּן־עֻזִּיאֵֽל׃

controles.web: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
controles.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.
controles.livre: E o chefe da casa do pai das famílias de Coate, Elisafã filho de Uziel.

versos.hebraico: וּמִשְׁמַרְתָּ֗ם הָאָרֹ֤ן וְהַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְהַמְּנֹרָ֣ה וְהַֽמִּזְבְּחֹ֔ת וּכְלֵ֣י הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָׁרְת֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨מָּסָ֔ךְ וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, and the screen, and all its service.
controles.kjv: And their charge shall be the ark, and the table, and the candlestick, and the altars, and the vessels of the sanctuary wherewith they minister, and the hanging, and all the service thereof.
controles.livre: E a cargo deles estará a arca, e a mesa, e o candelabro, e os altares, e os utensílios do santuário com que ministram, e o véu, com todo seu serviço.

versos.hebraico: וּנְשִׂיא֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י הַלֵּוִ֔י אֶלְעָזָ֖ר בֶּן־אַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֑ן פְּקֻדַּ֕ת שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֥רֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.
controles.kjv: And Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be chief over the chief of the Levites, and have the oversight of them that keep the charge of the sanctuary.
controles.livre: E o principal dos chefes dos levitas será Eleazar, filho de Arão o sacerdote, supervisor dos que têm a guarda do santuário.

versos.hebraico: לִמְרָרִ֕י מִשְׁפַּ֨חַת֙ הַמַּחְלִ֔י וּמִשְׁפַּ֖חַת הַמּוּשִׁ֑י אֵ֥לֶּה הֵ֖ם מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת מְרָרִֽי׃

controles.web: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.
controles.kjv: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites, and the family of the Mushites: these are the families of Merari.
controles.livre: De Merari, a família dos malitas e a família dos musitas: estas são as famílias de Merari.

versos.hebraico: וּפְקֻדֵיהֶם֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר כָּל־זָכָ֔ר מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה שֵׁ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Those who were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
controles.kjv: And those that were numbered of them, according to the number of all the males, from a month old and upward, were six thousand and two hundred.
controles.livre: E os contados deles conforme a conta de todos os homens de um mês acima, foram seis mil e duzentos.

versos.hebraico: וּנְשִׂ֤יא בֵֽית־אָב֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹ֣ת מְרָרִ֔י צוּרִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־אֲבִיחָ֑יִל עַ֣ל יֶ֧רֶךְ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֛ן יַחֲנ֖וּ צָפֹֽנָה׃

controles.web: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.
controles.kjv: And the chief of the house of the father of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail: these shall pitch on the side of the tabernacle northward.
controles.livre: E o chefe da casa do pai das famílias de Merari, Zuriel filho de Abiail: acamparão ao lado do tabernáculo, ao norte.

versos.hebraico: וּפְקֻדַּ֣ת מִשְׁמֶרֶת֮ בְּנֵ֣י מְרָרִי֒ קַרְשֵׁי֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן וּבְרִיחָ֖יו וְעַמֻּדָ֣יו וַאֲדָנָ֑יו וְכָל־כֵּלָ֔יו וְכֹ֖ל עֲבֹדָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,
controles.kjv: And under the custody and charge of the sons of Merari shall be the boards of the tabernacle, and the bars thereof, and the pillars thereof, and the sockets thereof, and all the vessels thereof, and all that serveth thereto,
controles.livre: E a cargo dos filhos de Merari estará a custódia das tábuas do tabernáculo, e suas barras, e suas colunas, e suas bases, e todos os seus utensílios, com todo seu serviço:

versos.hebraico: וְעַמֻּדֵ֧י הֶחָצֵ֛ר סָבִ֖יב וְאַדְנֵיהֶ֑ם וִיתֵדֹתָ֖ם וּמֵֽיתְרֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.
controles.kjv: And the pillars of the court round about, and their sockets, and their pins, and their cords.
controles.livre: E as colunas em derredor do átrio, e suas bases, e suas estacas, e suas cordas.

versos.hebraico: וְהַחֹנִ֣ים לִפְנֵ֣י הַמִּשְׁכָּ֡ן קֵ֣דְמָה לִפְנֵי֩ אֹֽהֶל־מוֹעֵ֨ד׀ מִזְרָ֜חָה מֹשֶׁ֣ה׀ וְאַהֲרֹ֣ן וּבָנָ֗יו שֹֽׁמְרִים֙ מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַמִּקְדָּ֔שׁ לְמִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃

controles.web: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.
controles.kjv: But those that encamp before the tabernacle toward the east, even before the tabernacle of the congregation eastward, shall be Moses, and Aaron and his sons, keeping the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the children of Israel; and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.
controles.livre: E os que acamparão diante do tabernáculo ao oriente, diante do tabernáculo do testemunho ao levante, serão Moisés, e Arão e seus filhos, tendo a guarda do santuário em lugar dos filhos de Israel: e o estranho que se aproximar, morrerá.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־פְּקוּדֵ֨י הַלְוִיִּ֜ם אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֧ה וְׄאַׄהֲׄרֹ֛ׄןׄ עַל־פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם כָּל־זָכָר֙ מִבֶּן־חֹ֣דֶשׁ וָמַ֔עְלָה שְׁנַ֥יִם וְעֶשְׂרִ֖ים אָֽלֶף׃ס

controles.web: All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
controles.kjv: All that were numbered of the Levites, which Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of the Lord, throughout their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty and two thousand.
controles.livre: Todos os contados dos levitas, que Moisés e Arão conforme a palavra do SENHOR contaram por suas famílias, todos os homens de um mês acima, foram vinte e dois mil.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֗ה פְּקֹ֨ד כָּל־בְּכֹ֤ר זָכָר֙ לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִבֶּן־חֹ֖דֶשׁ וָמָ֑עְלָה וְשָׂ֕א אֵ֖ת מִסְפַּ֥ר שְׁמֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Yahweh said to Moses, “Number all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
controles.kjv: And the Lord said unto Moses, Number all the firstborn of the males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR disse a Moisés: Conta todos os primogênitos homens dos filhos de Israel de um mês acima, e toma a conta dos nomes deles.

versos.hebraico: וְלָקַחְתָּ֨ אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֥ם לִי֙ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה תַּ֥חַת כָּל־בְּכֹ֖ר בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאֵת֙ בֶּהֱמַ֣ת הַלְוִיִּ֔ם תַּ֣חַת כָּל־בְּכ֔וֹר בְּבֶהֱמַ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: You shall take the Levites for me (I am Yahweh) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”
controles.kjv: And thou shalt take the Levites for me (I am the Lord) instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the cattle of the Levites instead of all the firstlings among the cattle of the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E tomarás os levitas para mim, eu o SENHOR, em lugar de todos os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel: e os animais dos levitas em lugar de todos os primogênitos dos animais dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּפְקֹ֣ד מֹשֶׁ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֑וֹ אֶֽת־כָּל־בְּכֹ֖ר בִּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: Moses numbered, as Yahweh commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
controles.kjv: And Moses numbered, as the Lord commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
controles.livre: E contou Moisés, como o SENHOR lhe mandou, todos os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִי֩ כָל־בְּכ֨וֹר זָכָ֜ר בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר שֵׁמ֛וֹת מִבֶּן־חֹ֥דֶשׁ וָמַ֖עְלָה לִפְקֻדֵיהֶ֑ם שְׁנַ֤יִם וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה וְשִׁבְעִ֖ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃פ

controles.web: All the firstborn males according to the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those who were numbered of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
controles.kjv: And all the firstborn males by the number of names, from a month old and upward, of those that were numbered of them, were twenty and two thousand two hundred and threescore and thirteen.
controles.livre: E todos os primogênitos homens, conforme a conta dos nomes, de um mês acima, os contados deles foram vinte e dois mil duzentos setenta e três.

versos.hebraico: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃

controles.web: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,
controles.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
controles.livre: E falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

versos.hebraico: קַ֣ח אֶת־הַלְוִיִּ֗ם תַּ֤חַת כָּל־בְּכוֹר֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת־בֶּהֱמַ֥ת הַלְוִיִּ֖ם תַּ֣חַת בְּהֶמְתָּ֑ם וְהָיוּ־לִ֥י הַלְוִיִּ֖ם אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am Yahweh.
controles.kjv: Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the Lord.
controles.livre: Toma os levitas em lugar de todos os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel, e os animais dos levitas em lugar de seus animais; e os levitas serão meus: Eu sou o SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵת֙ פְּדוּיֵ֣י הַשְּׁלֹשָׁ֔ה וְהַשִּׁבְעִ֖ים וְהַמָּאתָ֑יִם הָעֹֽדְפִים֙ עַל־הַלְוִיִּ֔ם מִבְּכ֖וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel, who exceed the number of the Levites,
controles.kjv: And for those that are to be redeemed of the two hundred and threescore and thirteen of the firstborn of the children of Israel, which are more than the Levites;
controles.livre: E pelos resgates dos duzentos e setenta e três, que excedem aos levitas os primogênitos dos filhos de Israel;

versos.hebraico: וְלָקַחְתָּ֗ חֲמֵ֧שֶׁת חֲמֵ֛שֶׁת שְׁקָלִ֖ים לַגֻּלְגֹּ֑לֶת בְּשֶׁ֤קֶל הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ תִּקָּ֔ח עֶשְׂרִ֥ים גֵּרָ֖ה הַשָּֽׁקֶל׃

controles.web: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; after the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs):
controles.kjv: Thou shalt even take five shekels apiece by the poll, after the shekel of the sanctuary shalt thou take them: (the shekel is twenty gerahs:)
controles.livre: Tomarás cinco siclos por cabeça; conforme o siclo do santuário tomarás: o siclo tem vinte óbolos:

versos.hebraico: וְנָתַתָּ֣ה הַכֶּ֔סֶף לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָ֑יו פְּדוּיֵ֕י הָעֹדְפִ֖ים בָּהֶֽם׃

controles.web: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”
controles.kjv: And thou shalt give the money, wherewith the odd number of them is to be redeemed, unto Aaron and to his sons.
controles.livre: E darás a Arão e a seus filhos o dinheiro pelos resgates dos que deles sobram.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּקַּ֣ח מֹשֶׁ֔ה אֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף הַפִּדְי֑וֹם מֵאֵת֙ הָעֹ֣דְפִ֔ים עַ֖ל פְּדוּיֵ֥י הַלְוִיִּֽם׃

controles.web: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;
controles.kjv: And Moses took the redemption money of them that were over and above them that were redeemed by the Levites:
controles.livre: Tomou, pois, Moisés o dinheiro do resgate dos que resultaram a mais dos resgatados pelos levitas:

versos.hebraico: מֵאֵ֗ת בְּכ֛וֹר בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָקַ֣ח אֶת־הַכָּ֑סֶף חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְשִׁשִּׁ֜ים וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת וָאֶ֖לֶף בְּשֶׁ֥קֶל הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃

controles.web: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
controles.kjv: Of the firstborn of the children of Israel took he the money; a thousand three hundred and threescore and five shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:
controles.livre: E recebeu dos primogênitos dos filhos de Israel em dinheiro, mil trezentos sessenta e cinco siclos, conforme o siclo do santuário.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֨ן מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֶת־כֶּ֧סֶף הַפְּדֻיִ֛ם לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן וּלְבָנָ֖יו עַל־פִּ֣י יְהוָ֑ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

controles.web: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to Yahweh’s word, as Yahweh commanded Moses.
controles.kjv: And Moses gave the money of them that were redeemed unto Aaron and to his sons, according to the word of the Lord, as the Lord commanded Moses.
controles.livre: E Moisés deu o dinheiro dos resgates a Arão e a seus filhos, conforme o dito do SENHOR, segundo que o SENHOR havia mandado a Moisés.
